title: Invoices
empty: No invoices yet. Create the first one to start tracking what you are owed.
emptyPayable: No bills yet. Add one to track what you owe.
noPayments: Nothing received against this invoice yet.
linkDescription: Pick the money that settled this invoice. Leave the amount blank to apply as much as fits.
noCandidates: No incoming transactions in this currency.
editDraftDescription: A draft can still change. Once the client has it, cancel it and issue a new one.

field.dueDateHint: When you expect to be paid. Your terms: {{days}} days.
field.amountHint: Leave blank to settle as much of the invoice as this payment covers.
field.linesOptional: Break down what you delivered, so the client sees what they are paying for.
field.dueDateHintPayable: When this has to be paid.

installments.title: Split into installments
installments.splitHint: equal parts, a month apart, from the due date
installments.label: Label
installments.mismatch: The installments add up to {{scheduled}}, the invoice to {{total}}.

deductions.title: Record a deduction
deductions.description: Close part of what is owed without money arriving: the client withheld tax, the processor kept its fee, the conversion landed short. It counts as settled, never as received.
deductions.differenceHint: Record the difference so the invoice closes

statement.asIssuedHint: The document sent to the client
statement.hint: Payments and deductions since issue, and the balance
statement.banner: This PDF is the invoice as issued. Since then {{paid}} was received and {{deducted}} deducted: the statement of account shows each one and the balance.
statement.title: Statement of account

noLinesHint: No line items: this invoice records an amount owed.

share.title: Share link
share.active: Anyone with this link can view the invoice.
share.revokeBody: People who have the link will no longer be able to open the invoice.

confirm.deleteBody: The draft is removed for good.
confirm.issueBody: It gets a number and its amounts can no longer change.
confirm.voidBody: It stays on record as void and no longer counts as owed.
confirm.writeOffBody: It stops counting as owed. You can reopen it later.
confirm.unlinkBody: The transaction stays; it just no longer settles this invoice.
confirm.removeDeductionBody: The amount goes back to the balance.

form.amountRequired: Enter the amount, or add line items.
form.lineInvalid: Check the quantity and price of each line.
form.taxInvalid: The tax rate must be between 0 and 100.

pay.title: Record payment
pay.partialLinkError: The payment was linked, but the deduction could not be recorded: {{error}}

deductForm.amountRequired: Enter an amount greater than zero.

pdfError: The PDF could not be downloaded.

errors.due_before_issue: The due date cannot come before the issue date.
errors.empty_total: An invoice with no value cannot be issued.
errors.not_a_draft: Only a draft can be issued.
errors.not_open: Only an open invoice can be settled.
errors.draft_not_voidable: Delete the draft instead of voiding it.
errors.void_with_allocations: Unlink the payments before voiding this invoice.
errors.only_drafts_deletable: An issued invoice is never deleted — void it instead.
errors.issued_invoice_immutable: An issued invoice cannot change. Void it and issue a new one.
errors.over_allocation: That is more than this invoice still owes.
errors.already_allocated: This transaction is already linked to this invoice.
errors.already_settled: This invoice is already fully settled.
errors.currency_mismatch: The transaction is in a different currency.
errors.terminal_status: This invoice can no longer be edited.
errors.not_uncollectible: Only an uncollectible invoice can be reopened.
errors.amount_not_positive: The amount must be greater than zero.
errors.draft_not_shareable: Issue the invoice before sharing it.
errors.payable_not_shareable: A bill you received cannot be shared.
errors.discount_exceeds_total: The discount is larger than the amount being billed.
errors.no_document_filed: This document was issued elsewhere. Attach the file that was received.
errors.installments_mismatch: The installments do not add up to the invoice total.
errors.installments_too_few: A schedule needs at least two installments.
errors.installment_amount_not_positive: Every installment must be worth something.
errors.installment_due_required: Every installment needs a due date.
errors.term_lines_required: A term needs at least one line.
errors.term_in_use: An invoice was already issued under this term. Add a new term from a later date.
errors.term_before_start: A term cannot start before the agreement does.
errors.term_date_taken: Another term already starts on that date.
errors.last_term: An agreement needs at least one term.
errors.schedule_ended: This agreement has ended and can no longer change.
errors.schedule_locked: The frequency, start date and currency are fixed once an invoice exists under this agreement.
errors.schedule_has_invoices: Invoices were issued under this agreement. End it instead of deleting it.
errors.schedule_not_active: Only an active agreement emits invoices.
errors.end_date_required: Say on which date the agreement ends.
errors.end_count_required: Say after how many invoices the agreement ends.
errors.end_before_start: The agreement cannot end before it starts.
errors.not_issued: Only an issued invoice can start an agreement.
errors.already_linked: This invoice already belongs to an agreement.
errors.invoice_void: A voided invoice cannot answer for a period.
errors.payee_mismatch: The invoice and the agreement name different clients.
errors.not_a_period: That date is not the start of a period of this agreement.
errors.beyond_end: That period is after the agreement ends.
errors.period_taken: Another invoice already answers for that period.
errors.start_after_invoice: The agreement cannot start after this invoice.
errors.no_term: No term is in force for this period.
errors.no_author: This agreement has no author to issue invoices as.
errors.first_term: The price in force from the start cannot be moved or removed. Change it, or add a new price from a later date.
errors.not_receivable: Only an invoice you issued can belong to an agreement.
errors.period_already_issued: This period was just issued. Refresh to see it.

schedules.title: Recurring
schedules.newDescription: An agreement with a client to bill them every period. The invoices are written for you, on the day.
schedules.empty: No recurring invoices yet. Set one up, or open an invoice and choose "Repeat this invoice".
schedules.paused: Paused. Nothing will be billed until you resume it.
schedules.resumed: Resumed from the next period on.
schedules.pausedByFailures: Paused after repeated failures. Check the terms and resume.
schedules.editDescription: The name, the client, the terms and when it ends.
schedules.editLockedDescription: Invoices were issued under this agreement, so its frequency and start date are fixed. Everything else can change.
schedules.endDescription: No more invoices will be issued. The ones already issued stay exactly as they are. Say why: it is the one thing the invoices cannot tell you later.
schedules.linkDescription: An invoice you wrote by hand for one of this agreement's periods. It keeps its number, its date and its payments; it only learns which period it was for.
schedules.noCandidates: No unlinked invoice for this client in this currency.
schedules.makeRecurringDescription: This invoice becomes one period of a new agreement, and the next ones are written for you. Its own date, {{date}}, is the first period unless you say the agreement started earlier.

field.name: Name
field.startDateHint: Earlier than the invoice makes room to link the ones before it.

terms.title: Price
terms.description: What the agreement bills per period, and from when. A change applies from the first period starting on or after its date; nothing is prorated.
terms.changeDescription: Record a new price from a date on. Periods already invoiced keep what they were billed; the change starts with the first period on or after the date, in full.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.description: One per period, written on the day. An invoice you wrote by hand can be linked too.
invoices.empty: No invoice under this agreement yet.
invoices.emptyNext: No invoice yet. The first one is written on {{date}}.

form.termsInvalid: Payment terms must be a whole number of days.

confirm.deleteBody: Nothing was billed under it, so nothing else changes.
confirm.generateBody: The next period is billed today instead of on its date.
confirm.removeTermBody: Periods from its date go back to the previous price.
confirm.unlinkBody: The invoice keeps its number, date and payments; it just no longer answers for a period.

settings.title: Invoice settings
settings.description: How invoicing behaves here, and how the document looks.
settings.presetTrackingHint: You invoice somewhere else. Here you follow who owes you and whether it arrived.
settings.presetDocumentHint: Securo writes the invoice your client receives. It needs what you are charging for.
settings.logoHint: Applies to invoices issued from now on. Documents already issued keep the logo they carried.
settings.paymentDetailsHint: How the client pays you — a Pix key, an IBAN, a bank account. Shown on the document.
settings.issuerHint: Appears as the sender on every invoice you issue from now on.
settings.labelsHint: Rename what the document calls each field.
settings.logoFailed: That image could not be used.

notesEdit.title: Edit notes
notesEdit.internalHint: Only you see these; they never appear on the document.
